Validate a sample_size_result object

Source: R/ssr-result.R
validate_sample_size_result.Rd

Validate a sample_size_result object

Usage

validate_sample_size_result(x)

Arguments

x

Object to validate; must inherit "sample_size_result" and carry at least design, design_type, and parameters fields; task and outcome (if present) must be character scalars.

Value

Invisible TRUE, or aborts with a structured error

Examples

r <- calculate("rct", "test", "mean", mean1 = 10, mean2 = 12, sd = 3)
SampleSizeCalc:::validate_sample_size_result(r)  # invisible TRUE
